name: zhiyun
description: Practical Intelligent Web Data Extraction Platform

scripts.build: pnpm run vendor:prepare && tsc --noEmit && pnpm -r --if-present build
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run vendor:prepare && vitest run desktop/packages
scripts.test:platform: pnpm run vendor:prepare && vitest run desktop/packages/platform-core desktop/packages/capabilities/storage-sqlite desktop/packages/capabilities/queue-local desktop/packages/capabilities/artifact-store
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run vendor:prepare && tsx desktop/tooling/scripts/test-isolated.ts desktop/packages/runtime/test
scripts.python:lint: uv run --frozen --project desktop/analytics-worker ruff check run_desktop.py run_platform.py tooling/python/development.py tooling/python/test_environment.py
scripts.python:format: uv run --frozen --project desktop/analytics-worker ruff format run_desktop.py run_platform.py tooling/python/development.py tooling/python/test_environment.py
scripts.python:format:check: uv run --frozen --project desktop/analytics-worker ruff format --check run_desktop.py run_platform.py tooling/python/development.py tooling/python/test_environment.py
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run vendor:prepare && tsc --noEmit && pnpm -r --if-present --workspace-concurrency=1 typecheck
scripts.worker:lint: cd desktop/analytics-worker && uv run ruff check src tests scripts packaging
scripts.worker:format: cd desktop/analytics-worker && uv run ruff format src tests scripts packaging
scripts.worker:openapi:generate: cd desktop/analytics-worker && uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py
scripts.worker:openapi:check: cd desktop/analytics-worker && uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py --check
scripts.worker:build: cd desktop/analytics-worker && uv run python scripts/build.py
scripts.worker:smoke: cd desktop/analytics-worker && uv run python scripts/smoke.py
scripts.architecture:deps: pnpm run vendor:prepare && depcruise --config dependency-cruiser.config.cjs desktop platform --output-type err
scripts.compliance:licenses: node tooling/scripts/generate-node-licenses.ts && cd desktop/analytics-worker && uv run python scripts/export_licenses.py ../../.artifacts/compliance/python.json
scripts.release:verify: pnpm run lint && pnpm run worker:lint && pnpm run python:lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run python:format:check && pnpm run architecture:deps && pnpm run architecture:check && pnpm run client:check && pnpm run worker:client:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run worker:test && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run dependency:audit && pnpm run compliance:licenses && pnpm run cloud:check
scripts.cloud:infra: docker compose -f platform/deploy/compose.yml up -d postgres redis
scripts.cloud:check: pnpm run cloud:contract:check && pnpm --filter "@zhiyun/cloud-*" typecheck && pnpm --filter @zhiyun/portal typecheck && pnpm --filter @zhiyun/admin typecheck
scripts.cloud:build: pnpm --filter @zhiyun/cloud-server build && pnpm --filter @zhiyun/portal build && pnpm --filter @zhiyun/admin build
